lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately seven visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, following a semi-regular grid-like distribution along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of blobs, forming rectangular nodes of high contrast at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running parallel along the upper mid-section of the flank, characterized by a light-intensity upper edge and a lower-intensity shadow gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the lower half and trailing edge of the fin.
